name: camera
description: A compact camera with a continuous curved body and circular lens.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner-requested rounder unboxed camera with the left/right primary edge pair at exactly 2 native units. Both style exteriors span x=2..22 and y=3.49175127..20.50824873, centered at 12,12. The natural horizontal body proportions are retained (20 by 17.01649746); the shorter vertical axis is not stretched to force 2px top/bottom margins. Outline uses circular tangent fillets and unchanged Regular 1.70 stroke. Filled exterior is the exact 0.85 outward offset of the same lines and arcs, increasing convex radii and reducing concave radii while keeping arc centers fixed. No enclosing box is added. Camera body corner radii are 2.75 at shoulders and 3.25 at the base; the raised housing has softened .8/1.05 transitions. The owner then requested lowering the raised housing by .75 unit relative to the body. The complete drawing is recentered upward by .375 unit, including lens and indicator; circle radii remain unchanged; Filled counters remain their established fixed geometry. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0. Owner-approved source. Global weight update requested by owner on2026-10-27: default Regular1.75 (half-width .875), Thin1.25 and Bold2.50, adjustable in .25 increments. Filled is rebuilt from these same Outline centerlines using rounded normal expansion, with solid-head/boxed/object semantics preserved. Menu/Search Filled follows Bold2.50. Centerlines uniformly refitted about12,12 by 0.9972677596 to retain the existing2px primary margins and shared boxed glyph clearance. Earlier1.70/2.25 construction measurements are historical; the current default reference is1.75.

review.note: Owner approved both Outline and Filled after rounder corners, exact 2px left/right primary margins, and the .75-unit lower raised housing. Reviewed at native proportions and Regular 1.70.
